instructions_en.title: How to Complete This Form
steps: This form tracks an individual's progress on independence goals throughout the month. Complete one form per goal, per month.
The form is divided into 4 weekly tracking periods. For each period, record:
Client Name: Enter the full name of the individual whose goal is being tracked.
Goal: Write the specific independence goal being worked on (e.g., "Increase independent living skills focused on meal preparation").
Effective Date: Enter the date this goal became active.
Month / Year: Enter the month and year you are tracking (e.g., "December 2025").

instructions_en.title: For Each Week
steps: # of times individual worked on the goal: Enter the number of times during that week period. Must be 1 or more times per week.
# of times provider supported individual: Enter how many times you provided support to help increase their independence related to this goal.
Type of support provided: Check all that apply: - Verbal - Verbal prompts, encouragement, or instructions
Supervision - Watching and monitoring the individual
Physical Assistance - Hands-on help with the task
Other - Specify any other type of support

instructions_en.title: The Four Weekly Periods
steps: At the end of the tracking period, evaluate whether to continue this goal:
Days 1-7 (First week)
Days 8-14 (Second week)
Days 15-21 (Third week)
Days 22-31 (Fourth week/end of month)
Does the individual still express interest? Select Yes or No.
If No: Describe what new goal the individual wants to work on.
What would be needed: List resources, training, or support needed to implement the new goal.
Provider able to assist? Indicate if you can help with the new goal.
If not able: Explain why you cannot assist with achieving the new goal.
Additional Comments / Notes: Add any relevant observations, progress notes, barriers encountered, or successes achieved.
Provider Signature: Enter your name to certify this information.
Date: Select the date you completed this form.
Click Submit to finalize the form.
